sentences.text:
Gist of the complaint averments would reveal that petitioner No.1/accused No.1 married respondent No.2 as per the Muslim rights and customs on 27.07.2020 NC:
2025:KHC-K:3714 HC-KAR at Eaden Function Hall, Mailoor, Bidar district.
The couple lived happily for some time and a girl child born to them.
3.3 Petitioner No.1/accused No.1 being an Engineer, was earlier working in Egypt and thereafter, he had come back to India.

3.4 After the birth of girl child, there were frequent quarrels and petitioner Nos.4 to 7/accused Nos.4 to 7, who were residing in the vicinity of the house of the complainant, used to instigate petitioner No.1 to insult respondent No.2 by abusing her in filthy language.

3.5 Such incidents were reported to the parental house of respondent No.2 and at that juncture, brothers of respondent No.2 visited the matrimonial house of respondent No.2 and requested them to lookafter her properly.

3.6 When the matter stood thus, on 15.02.2022 at about 9.30 p.m., petitioner Nos.2 and 3 and other NC: 2025:KHC-K:3714 HC-KAR petitioners joined together and told respondent No.2 to snap the matrimonial tie on the ground that she is not good looking woman and if she does not agree for the said proposal, they will kill her.
3.7 Some how the respondent No.2 tolerated all those insults.

Again on 07.07.2023 at about 5.00 p.m., when respondent No.2 was in her parental house, petitioner No.3/accused No.3 visited her parental house along with petitioner No.1/accused No.1 and abused respondent No.2 in filthy language and assaulted her with hands.
3.8 Based on the said complaint, police registered the case, investigated the matter and yet to file the charge sheet.
In the mean time, petitioners have approached this Court with the aforesaid prayer.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners contended that the complaint is a cleverly drafted in retaliation to the divorce petition filed by petitioner No.1 and therefore,
NC: 2025:KHC-K:3714 HC-KAR there is no iota of truth in any one of the allegations levelled against the petitioners and sought for allowing the petition.
5.
Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent No.1 and learned counsel for respondent No.2 support filing of the complaint against the petitioners.

sentences.text: Pertinently, the divorce petition filed by petitioner No.1 is earlier to filing of the present complaint.

Likewise, it is noted that except general and omnibus allegations levelled against petitioner Nos.4 to 7/accused Nos.4 to 7, who are admittedly not residing with petitioner Nos.1 to 3/accused Nos.1 to 3 and respondent No.2 at any point of time and did not share the common roof, continuation of criminal proceedings against against petitioner Nos.4 to 7/accused Nos.4 to 7 would only result in abuse of process of the Court.
As such the pending complaint needs to be quashed against them.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:3714 HC-KAR 7.

View of this Court in this regard is supported by the principles of law enunciated by the Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam vs. The State Of Bihar reported in (2022) 6 SCC 599.
8.

Accordingly, following order is passed:
ORDER a) Criminal petition is allowed in part.
b) Petition against petitioner Nos.1 to 3/accused Nos.1 to 3 is dismissed.
c) Pending criminal proceedings in Crime No.8/2024 of Bidar Women Police Station is hereby quashed in respect of petitioner Nos.4 to 7, who are accused Nos.4 to 7.
d) Ordered accordingly.
Sd/-
